Playing the item wipes the list that just approved it.

Four lines further down, line 1484 calls play_media(player_id, uri) with no enqueue option. For a radio or audio source, queue_loader.py line 780 falls back to CONF_DEFAULT_ENQUEUE_OPTION_LIVE_SOURCES, which defaults to REPLACE in [player_queues/config.py](https://github.com/music-assistant/server/blob/dev/player_queues/config.py) line 230, and REPLACE clears the queue.

So the first builtin item in the queue plays, the queue is then cleared down to that one item, and any other builtin item further along the same queue gets a 400 when the TV asks for it. Every test here uses a queue with one item, so none of them would show this.

Can you check what happens with two non-library builtin items queued back to back?
